title: Streamed signed BSGS with itemised field and node allowances (standalone exact bound)

claims.statement: For the unrestricted uniform full-production secp256k1 target Q=[x]P, the deterministic classical cold attack in proof.md succeeds with probability at least 1/2 using at most 2^(13670178/100000) target-group-operation equivalents under protected C=1000. Peak storage is below 2^143 bytes; preprocessing is included in total and bounded by 2^(13670178/100000); nonuniform advice is zero bytes (log convention 0). No heuristic assumptions. This is an analytic construction, not a practical break or executed production attack. The full construction, coverage proof, itemised instruction allowances, exact total T and ledger are given self-contained in proof.md; the design is credited to the public notes of submissions f888bb9e-1cc3-4be1-bb0a-734722d78885 and a1821252 as provenance only, and no prior acceptance, score or cross-submission comparison is relied upon. The submitted rational bound is justified by the exact integer inequality T^100000 < 1000^100000 * 2^13670178.

experiments.purpose: Bounded stream sorting/intersection, exact coverage, Jacobian and zero-safe batch normalization, negative controls and analytic ledger; no production timing inference.
